Thanks Karthik — I ran a first-pass scoring and attached the Hot25 (top25_hotlist_20260503.pdf). Quick notes on the rubric I used:

Scoring (0–10 each):
- Role relevance (data/ML infra/dev ops): up to 10
- Company fit (rev band + industry): up to 8
- Intent signals (questions, chat, resource requests): up to 7
- Existing infra compatibility (mentions of GPU/cloud infra): up to 5

High-confidence picks (top 10) show at least two intent signals and a role that maps to our target buyer. The next 15 are warm — good for a 2-step nurture + demo offer.

I flagged three accounts with procurement/security notes for Neha: entries 7, 13, 19 in the Hot25 PDF.

Attachments: top25_hotlist_20260503.pdf (stub).

Proposed next steps:
1) Marcus to assign top 10 to named SDRs by noon.
2) Avery to seed two demo slots per SDR today (Calendly link below).
3) We tag MQLs in HubSpot and create a simple MAP (we can use the MAP template I linked).

Putting this on your plate Marcus — can you confirm assignment cadence?

—Grace
